observations.observation: The lossless delta establishes that all original cells remain unchanged. Financials!P12 and Q12 still calculate total percentage growth divided by years under the CAGR heading, rather than compound annual growth, unlike the neighboring CAGR formulas.

Debt interest formulas remain based on the average of beginning balance and signed repayment, instead of beginning and ending debt balances. For example, G145 averages G141 with voluntary repayment G143, although G144 is the ending balance. This understates interest even when no repayment occurs and omits mandatory amortization from the balance calculation used for interest.
